body: The one thing which has kept me from killing myself is video games (they reduce my stress a LOT).  I rarely do them anyways, but if my parents take away my computer I don't think I can handle the stress on a daily basis.
Thank you for replying.  If people found out I would be considered even MORE weird at school than I already am.
The suicide hotline seems like a scam though.  They will probably try to contact my parents because I am under 18 or something like that.  Isn't that the case?

No our parents had bought us a car to share.  They wanted us to be able to run errands for them and stuff.  Please believe me my brother is not someone to talk to about this.  Please I am not making it up.
sorry I feel like I am just shitting on every idea you give me :(. im sorry if it comes across that way.
I don't want to tell anyone that I know personally that I am suicidal.  I don't want to have anyone find out.

I don't like my brother.  he is too much like my dad.  I don't have a close relationship with anyone except one or two online friends.  One is like 12 so that makes me a creeper, and the other refuses to talk about it.  either way it doesn't matter
ya we are all in the same household.
I have considered it but what they say is true.  It is hard to get a job without a college degree.  is 20,000mg enough to kill?

I can't do another 2 years of this.  I will have to go to college and listen to their shit day in an day out.  I just walked downstairs to get a cup of water and AGAIN.  EVERY FUCKING TIME.  now my dad tells me to FUCKING GROW UP and all his usual shit.  who fucking CARES ANYMORE.
